lines: In his old age, Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, stood in the valley that had once been empty, and he made a dua that Muslims still recite today.
"My Lord, make this city secure, and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols."
Praise be to Allah, who gave me in my old age Ismail and Ishaq. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.
"My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and from my descendants too. Our Lord, and accept my dua."
"Our Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and the believers, on the Day the account is established."
And Muslims still make this dua today. The words of Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, kept in the Quran, still on our tongues.
